answer: Before an answer can draw emission, its author must post a chain of at least three prior job receipts, each countersigned by a different established non-kin peer and time-locked for a week. A farm cannot stash those receipts in a quiet lagoon of sockpuppets, because every slip names one job hash and one signer key; clones fail the check at once. That requirement is the summit of the filter: cheap names may still be minted, but they cannot wander into the emission pool without a countersignature backlog they cannot honestly fill.
